base.note: Focused presentation-only patch over v1.6.3; no session-core/storage or data semantics changed.

changes.TENTATIVE_DOT_164: Candidate/tentative state is shown only by a yellow ● control/mark; it no longer paints the whole answer yellow.
changes.CROSSOUT_FEEDBACK_164: Crossed answers keep line-through semantics without global opacity or muted answer-letter styling, so green/red review feedback remains visible.
changes.FEEDBACK_PRECEDENCE_164: Explicit CSS guard ensures .option.correct/.option.wrong colors override scratch candidate/crossed presentation.
changes.QRV2_LEGACY_STRONG_164: QRV2 safely recognizes legacy **Label:** and **inline** spans after escaping; no general Markdown/HTML parser is introduced.
changes.QRV2_READABILITY_164: Legacy labels become separate readable units and QRV2 list/paragraph spacing and line-height are increased.
changes.V163_PLANNER_PRESERVED: MEDIA134 unlock/high-observed interleave logic from v1.6.3 is unchanged.
changes.PROTECTED_SESSION_FILES: session-core.js and session-storage.js remain byte-identical to the protected baseline.

supabase_migration.note: No migration. Presentation-only frontend patch; stored question content is not rewritten.

dataset_revision_note: Latest confirmed production postcheck: 74/74 MEDIA134 #61–134 updated/history/backed up; 44 review flags remained open.

qa.manual_smoke: Verify visible v1.6.4; tentative ● stays yellow while submitted answer is green/red; crossed answer preserves green/red with line-through; legacy QRV2 **Label:** renders without visible asterisks and with separate readable units.
